info.name: PromptLayer Evaluations & Datasets Logging & Tracking API

items.docs: Logs a provider-agnostic LLM request to PromptLayer using the Prompt Blueprint format for input and output, including timing, parameters, token usage, price, tags, and metadata.

info.name: Associate a prompt template with a logged request

items.docs: Associates a prompt template (by name, with optional version or release label) and its input variables with a previously logged PromptLayer request.

info.name: Attach a score to a logged request

items.docs: Attaches a 0-100 integer score, optionally named, to a logged request.

info.name: Attach metadata to a logged request

items.docs: Attaches a custom key-value metadata dictionary to a logged request.
